strategy_roster.name: Close Cross MA
strategy_roster.notes: Reference strategy is not expressible as a deterministic single-security OHLCV entry signal in the TASI DSL; a never-true guard is used rather than fabricating a signal. Unsupported schedule, portfolio, order-management, external-data, or multi-order mechanics are not represented.

strategy_roster.name: RSI & Backed-Weighted MA
strategy_roster.notes: ATR/volatility reference translated using ATR versus its rolling average; absolute point/pip risk controls are not encoded.

strategy_roster.name: SV Daily Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: Donchian/breakout reference translated with prior-bar 14-bar channel bounds to avoid current-bar look-ahead. Additional unsupported stateful filters are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: MACD and SAR
strategy_roster.notes: MACD-based reference translated to the local MACD 12/26/9-style DSL using documented periods where available; unsupported platform-specific filters/order handling are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: NTK_07 Grid
strategy_roster.notes: Donchian/breakout reference translated with prior-bar 0-bar channel bounds to avoid current-bar look-ahead. Additional unsupported stateful filters are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Color Zerolag RSI OSMA
strategy_roster.notes: RSI reference translated with period 14 and documented/default thresholds; platform-specific oscillator variants are simplified.

strategy_roster.name: MA2CCI
strategy_roster.notes: CCI is approximated by a z-score of typical price because the local DSL has no dedicated CCI function; documented period is preserved where available.

strategy_roster.name: AMS ES RSI
strategy_roster.notes: ATR/volatility reference translated using current-period ATR relative to its rolling average; absolute price-step risk controls are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Ichimoku RSI
strategy_roster.notes: Ichimoku is approximated with a fast/slow EMA cloud-direction proxy because native Ichimoku components are not in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: GreenTrade
strategy_roster.notes: RSI reference translated with period 57 and documented/default thresholds; platform-specific oscillator variants are simplified.
